description: Na₆Ti₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.94 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.55 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent TiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.64 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent TiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.35 Å. Ti is bonded to four O atoms to form TiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one TiO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 21°. There are three shorter (1.82 Å) and one longer (1.91 Å) Ti-O bond length. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Ti atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and one Ti atom to form distorted ONa₄Ti trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent ONa₅Ti octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₄Ti trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₅Ti octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-75°. In the third O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Ti atom to form distorted ONa₅Ti octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₅Ti octahedra, corners with five equivalent ONa₄Ti trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent ONa₅Ti octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₄Ti trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ti atoms.
